verdict: approve — the shape is sound. This is a well-executed deletion story: tag-first preservation, a single small structural addition (the reverse docs check), clean lockstep removal across install/gate/CI, and an honest pin-prune with stated bar and evidence. One inconsistency between the file's stated pin bar and 5 of its 19 pins is worth Thomas's attention but does not undermine the approach.

findings.title: Five "crept back" absent pins contradict the file's own behavioral bar
findings.locus: tests/reviewer_test.sh — pin section header + the "retired falsification machinery" block
findings.claim: The file header states the bar twice: "a pin earns its place ONLY if its silent failure would let BEHAVIOR degrade unnoticed" and the section header repeats "Each one is here because its silent failure degrades behavior — the reason is stated with it. Nothing else qualifies." Then the last pin block immediately includes 5 `absent` pins explicitly commented "Not a behavior guard — a decision guard." These check that removed constructs ("surfaces excluded", "place, not a mechanism", "in exactly three permitted forms", "No circular oracles", "Falsification-plan amendments") have not reappeared in frame/SKILL.md. They are spec-authorized (AC-2's demonstrate-red row plans them), but they do not meet the behavioral-degradation criterion AC-4 enumerates and the header declares. The next person reading the file sees a clear rule and then 5 pins that break it, and must guess which is wrong — the rule or the pins. That ambiguity is exactly the kind of unexamined regrowth the pins themselves exist to prevent, applied to the pin set.
findings.alternative: Either (a) amend the header and section comment to name a second, explicitly bounded class — decision-guard pins that protect against ceremony regrowth, each with a stated reason and a note that they are NOT behavior guards — so the stated bar honestly covers what the file practices; or (b) remove the 5 pins and rely on the step-6 design review (which critiques test notes at the same altitude) to catch conceptual regrowth of the old machinery, accepting that exact-phrase paste-back would not be caught mechanically.
findings.win: (a) makes the file's stated bar honest in one comment edit — the next person gets a clear two-tier rule instead of a contradiction; (b) makes the pin set fully consistent with AC-4's principle, removing 5 pins that don't meet the bar the story fought to establish. Either resolves the discrepancy; the current state leaves the file arguing with itself.
